description: This Java class implements a conditional operation comparable to an 'if' statement based on comparing two fields in a mini-language used by the Apache OFBiz framework. It supports evaluating conditions using different operators, formats, and type conversions, and can execute nested sub-operations depending on the condition's result.

classes.name: CompareFieldCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional check comparing two fields with various operators and executing nested operations based on the evaluation.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition between the specified fields using the defined operator and format.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes nested sub-operations based on the condition's outcome.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations for analysis or documentation.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable description of the current condition and its operands.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the condition into an XML-like string representation.

methods.name: CompareFieldCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition based on an XML element description, parsing attributes and nested operations.
